encoding.n: rows of support state x among N replicated rows; P(x) = n / N
encoding.pi_pct: P(S=1 | x) in percent (integer); S = 1 plays women, 0 men
encoding.derived: qI(x) = (1 - pi) inc_S0 + pi inc_S1; qO(x) = (1 - pi) occ_S0 + pi occ_S1; qO0 = occ_S0; qO1 = occ_S1 (all exact rationals with denominator 10^4)
encoding.cells: witness / comparator cell index per state, in state order: inc_cell in 0..KI-1, occ_cell in 0..KO-1

common.route_params: nrm.fa.prc.route_params('PRC_S2') for the protected path and route_params('PRC_TWIN') for the twin (code defaults; only KI, KO and the rows differ)

tilt_ranges.card: t in (0, lambda] (card FA_PRC_v1: t <= lambda)
tilt_ranges.wide: t in (0, 4 lambda] (outside the card's declared tilt range; informative only)

common.emitted_tables: B1 analogue: exact posterior means of the final cells (population teacher means = population label refit)

A_null.kind: (a) calibrated null: S independent of X (pi = 0.40 for every x); occupation depends on S, so the guard term is active, but every release has exact Bayes AUC 0.5 in every view

zero_recovery_comparator.note: task-natural grouping; exact AUC 0.5 by construction (S independent of X)

B_collide.kind: (b) genuine task-score collisions: four pairs of states with identical (qI, qO) and different pi; occupation and income independent of S given x (qO0 = qO1 = qO), so colliding states are identical in every task and guard statistic and differ only in pi

witness.note: split the boundary collision pair: b5 (pi 0.10) joins the A cell, b6 (pi 0.90) joins the B cell; NOT expressible by any h(q) (b5 and b6 have identical task posteriors)

C_distinct.kind: (c) no collisions: all eight (qI, qO) distinct; pi correlated with the task scores (A-like occupation high, B-like low); c7 and c8 have S-dependent occupation (guard active) with the stated mixture
C_distinct.comparator: no hand-built witness; the STEP 4 AUC-under-utility optimum (a relaxation unless shown realizable) is the comparator

D_witness.kind: (d) independently checked feasible many-to-one witness: two cheap occupation merges compete; the task-optimal merge (A1 with A2) keeps recovery, the witness merge (C1 with C2, pi 0.20 vs 0.70) lowers it; all posteriors distinct, so every partition is h(q)-expressible

witness.note: merge C1 and C2 (d3, d4), keep A1 and A2 apart

E_distinct_N200.kind: (e) shrinkage regime: the population law of C_distinct on N = 200 replicated rows (every n divided by 10), so the 20 pseudo-counts of the routing tables weigh 10 times more against the cell masses; the population objective is unchanged
